brand.name: Allbirds
brand.summary: Allbirds sells comfortable shoes and apparel made from natural materials such as Merino wool, eucalyptus/tree fiber, and sugarcane. The site emphasizes comfort, natural materials, free shipping and returns, and certified B Corp status. The brand was founded in New Zealand in 2007 by Tim Brown and launched with the Wool Runner in 2016.
brand.business_overview: Allbirds operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce store at allbirds.com. The homepage promotes a holiday sale of up to 70% off and organizes products into Men's Shoes, Women's Shoes, Men's Apparel, Women's Apparel, Socks, Leather Alternatives, All-Weather, and the Terralux™ Collection. Specific product names observed include Wool Runner, Tree Runner NZ, Runner NZ, Cruiser, Canvas Cruiser, Tree Breezer, Dasher NZ, Kiwi Clog, and Allbirds Slipper. The site also publishes sustainability content, including a blog post about M0.0NSHOT, a product with a claimed 0.0 CO₂e carbon footprint.
brand.business_model: Direct-to-consumer e-commerce with free shipping and returns; sale and clearance sections (Holiday Sale, Final Few) are promoted on the homepage.
